visual.general_description: Grayscale transoesophageal echocardiogram sector image with a red arrow pointing to a bright echogenic focus on the left side of the sector.
visual.detailed_description: A single grayscale ultrasound sector (fan-shaped field) with its apex at the top centre, a small green "V" marker near the apex, depth tick numbers 5, 10 and 15 along the left edge, a small fan-shaped probe-angle icon at the top right with the printed number "55", a vertical grayscale bar at the right edge, and a single-lead ECG trace along the lower left with "75" and "HR" printed at the lower right. In the near field there is a dark chamber-like region at the top, and in the mid field a rounded structure with internal echogenic leaflet-like lines lies right of centre. A red arrow runs from the upper left toward a small bright echogenic focus at the left margin of this rounded structure, adjacent to an elongated grey echogenic band. Below, a bright curved echogenic band and speckled darker regions are seen. No panel letters, calibration scale in cm or measurement calipers are visible.

evidence.quote: Transoesophageal echocardiogram showing echogenic shadowing of at least 2.5 by 1.3 cm in diameter on the right ventricular pacing lead consistent with vegetation.
This finding indicated vegetation on the ventricular pacing lead, suggesting a likely diagnosis of endocarditis of the ventricular pacing lead (Figure 1).
